brief: Evan, 2026-10-23: exotic alien plants that grow from the paint. Low-poly, hi-fi, kid-friendly, with growth stages sprout, grow, bloom.

parts.head: the part that opens: bell, fronds, poms, caps, star discs (named 'head')
parts.glow-parts: beads, spots, pods lit at night (named 'glow-parts')

materials.alien-plant-glow: emissive, cloned per plant, intensity follows bloom and night

stages.sprout: 0 to .33: two seed leaves and a short stalk

decisions: One plant per paint colour so colour teaches the species.
Three meshes per plant, shared geometry, so thirty plants stay near 100 draws.
Fern uncurls by rewriting one position buffer, never rebuilding geometry.
differences_from_modeler_vision: Built as JavaScript recipes (three.js), not Blender Python and GLB. Intent and parts are recorded here; a Blender build.py and GLB export is the next step so the plants join the model store.

revisions.note: First five species; viewer in Tab 2 of the study.
